summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Vanguard U.S. Value Factor ETF (VFVA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund of US equities with lower share prices relative to fundamental values, as determined by the manager. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation. VFVA was launched on Feb 13, 2018 and is issued by Vanguard.

holdings.infoBox: VFVA is an equity ETF with a total of 669 individual holdings. The top holdings are CVS Health stock at 0.95%, EOG Resources at 0.84%, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company at 0.84%, The Cigna Group at 0.80%, and Salesforce at 0.77%.
